overview.title: Platform overview
overview.description: Companies, usage and gateway health across the platform.
overview.firstCompanyHint: Add a company, brand it, give it gateway keys and invite its first administrator. Usage appears here once its people start working.
overview.unpriced_one: {{count, number}} request in this range had no model price, so the cost shown does not include it. Set prices under Prices.
overview.unpriced_other: {{count, number}} requests in this range had no model price, so the cost shown does not include them. Set prices under Prices.

keyPool.title: Gateway key pool
keyPool.empty: No keys yet. <link>Add the first key</link> so companies can reach the gateway.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Everything the platform owner did, newest first. Read-only.

empty.noMatchHint: No loaded event matches these filters. Load older events or clear a filter.
empty.nothingHint: Actions taken in this console appear here.

keys.title: Gateway keys
keys.description: The keys the platform owns. Companies use them through their assignments; nobody else ever sees them.

empty.title: No gateway keys yet
empty.hint: Add the first key so companies can reach the model gateway. The key is stored encrypted and only its last four characters are shown.

disableDialog.title: Disable {{label}}?
disableDialog.used_one: {{count}} company uses this key. They fall back to their other assigned keys; a company with no other active key loses gateway access.
disableDialog.used_other: {{count}} companies use this key. They fall back to their other assigned keys; a company with no other active key loses gateway access.

addDialog.title: Add a gateway key
addDialog.description: The key is stored encrypted and never shown again.
addDialog.label: Label
addDialog.labelHint: A name for the pool, e.g. Primary or Backup.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate {{label}}
rotateDialog.description: Replace the stored key text. Companies keep their assignment.

prices.title: Model prices
prices.description: What a million tokens cost, per model. Usage reports use the price in force when the request was made; an edit adds a new version and never rewrites history.

empty.title: No prices yet
empty.hint: Without a price, requests are metered but their cost reads as zero. Add the models your companies use.

dialog.description: Amounts are US dollars per one million tokens, up to six decimals.
dialog.effectiveHint: Leave empty to apply now. A future date schedules the change.

errors.model: Enter the model id exactly as the gateway names it (no spaces).
errors.amount: Use a non-negative amount of at most 6 decimals and at most {{max}}.
errors.pastDate: The date cannot be in the past.

empty.noneHint: Create the first company: name it, brand it, give it gateway keys and invite its administrator.
empty.noMatchHint: Try another name or code, or clear the filters.

detail.suspendedBody: Its members and administrators cannot sign in or use the gateway. Nothing was deleted; reactivate it to restore access.

suspendDialog.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspendDialog.effect: Members lose access immediately: sign-in, the admin console and every model request stop until you reactivate the company. Nothing is deleted.

reactivateDialog.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivateDialog.description: Members and administrators regain access immediately.

overviewTab.finishBody: Members cannot use Forge until this company has at least one gateway key and a set of allowed models.

brandingTab.intro: Revision {{revision}}. The company's members see this look in their app and on the join page.
brandingTab.readOnly: Reactivate the company to change its branding.
brandingTab.editorDescription: The previews follow every edit. This console keeps its own look.
brandingTab.resetDescription: Reset to the Prometheon default? This publishes a new revision; the history is kept.
brandingTab.resetDone: Branding reset to the Prometheon default (revision {{revision}}).

keysTab.intro: The company reaches the gateway through these platform keys, tried in order. Only the label and the last four characters are ever shown.
keysTab.emptyHint: Without a key the company's members cannot use any model.
keysTab.readOnly: Reactivate the company to change its keys.
keysTab.noneActive: No assigned key is active, so the company has no gateway access.
keysTab.addField: Add a key from the pool
keysTab.noMore: No more keys in the pool
keysTab.removeLast: This is the last key. The company will lose access to the gateway until another key is assigned.
keysTab.removeOther: The company stops using this key once you save.

membersTab.intro: The people of this company, as its administrators see them. Changes are made by the company's own administrators.
membersTab.caption: Company members
membersTab.emptyNoneHint: People appear here once they accept their invitation.
membersTab.emptyNoMatchHint: Try a different name or email address.

modelsTab.notDiscovered: Refresh the models from the company's keys first; allowed models are chosen from what the keys can reach.
modelsTab.catalogIntro: Discover the models this company's keys can reach, choose which ones it may use under which names, and publish. Company administrators see the published catalog and can only narrow it.
modelsTab.notReachableFailure: One or more selected models are not reachable through this company's keys. Refresh the models and choose from the list.

table.caption: Allowed models
table.emptyHint: Until at least one model is allowed, the company cannot publish a catalogue.

modelsTab.editorIntro: The most this company's administrators can publish to their members. Choose among the models the company's keys can reach. A model without a price is metered but costs nothing in reports until you set one under Prices.
modelsTab.readOnly: Reactivate the company to change its models.

usageTab.intro: Usage metered through the gateway for this company, by UTC day.
usageTab.emptyHint: Usage appears here after the company's members send their first request through the gateway.
usageTab.unpriced_one: {{count, number}} request had no model price; its cost is not included. Set prices under Prices.
usageTab.unpriced_other: {{count, number}} requests had no model price; their cost is not included. Set prices under Prices.
usageTab.estimated_one: {{count, number}} request was measured by estimate because the gateway did not report usage.
usageTab.estimated_other: {{count, number}} requests were measured by estimate because the gateway did not report usage.

catalogPanel.label: Catalog
catalogPanel.noKeyBody: Assign at least one gateway key to this company in the Keys tab, then come back to discover the models it can use.
catalogPanel.noKeyAnswered: No key answered, so nothing was stored. The models below are from the last successful discovery.
catalogPanel.emptyHintReadOnly: Reactivate the company to discover models.
catalogPanel.emptyHint: Use Discover models to ask the assigned keys what they can reach.
catalogPanel.missing: Published but not in the latest discovery: {{models}}. Publishing again drops them.
catalogPanel.readOnly: Reactivate the company to change its catalog.
catalogPanel.noKeys: No keys are assigned to this company.

wizard.title: Create a company
wizard.description: Name it, brand it, give it gateway keys and invite its first administrator.
wizard.invitationFailedTitle: The invitation email could not be sent
wizard.invitationFailedBody: The company exists. Share the company code and ask {{email}} to use a password reset, or contact support to resend the invitation.
wizard.failedBody: The company exists. {{message}} Retry the failed steps, or finish setup from the company page.

company.name: Company name
company.codeHint: Employees type it in the app. 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens; it cannot change later.
company.departmentHint: Where the first administrator is placed; more departments can be added later.

branding.defaultNote: The company starts with the default Prometheon look. Its administrators can change it later.

admin.intro: This person receives the invitation email and becomes the company's administrator.
admin.name: Administrator name

keys.intro: The company uses these platform keys, in this order; the first is tried first.
keys.none: There is no usable key in the pool. Add one under Gateway keys first.
keys.modelsNote: Models are published from the company's Models tab after it is created; the models you publish there are the ones the company may use.

errors.code: Use 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
errors.keysMin: Select at least one gateway key.
errors.keysMax: A company can have at most 16 keys.

gate.errorDescription: Your platform session could not be checked.

enroll.introDescription: The platform console needs a second factor. Set up an authenticator app (Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, 1Password…) to continue.
enroll.scanDescription: Scan it with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enroll.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
enroll.cannotScan: Cannot scan? Enter this secret by hand:

step.title: Verify it is you
step.descriptionRecovery: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each works once.
step.descriptionCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to open the console.

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.description: Each code opens the console once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now.
recovery.warning: Store them somewhere safe, apart from this device. They cannot be shown again.
recovery.stored: I stored them in a safe place
